rules.name: Search Engine Discovery of Sensitive Content
rules.description: Detects search engine crawlers accessing sensitive paths like /admin, /.env, /.git, /wp-admin, /backup, /config
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg01_001", "action" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'VcnFlowLogs' AND "action" = 'REJECT' AND "srcaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "dstaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "value" > 0

rules.name: Web Server Fingerprinting via Headers
rules.description: Detects verbose server headers disclosing technology stack versions enabling targeted attacks
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg01_002", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%web%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%server%') AND "value" > 0
